snippet.title: Glassbreakers Showcase | Gameplay Footage: BlitzVR vs Polyarc
snippet.description:
Glassbreakers is launching November 13, 2025 on Meta Quest 3|3S, Steam VR and Apple Vision Pro via Apple Arcade subscription.

🔗 Meta: https://vr.meta.me/s/2rUC88DGrzH8A8S
🔗 Steam: https://store.steampowered.com/app/887330/Glassbreakers_Champions_of_Moss?utm_source=yt&utm_medium=description
🔗 Apple Arcade: https://apps.apple.com/us/app/glassbreakers/id6596780523

---

Lead your squad of Champions into a fast-paced and tactile competitive arena where tactics, magic, and power collide. Command your team, protect the glass, and dominate the battlefield in this real-time clash of Champions!

Join the Discord: https://discord.gg/polyarcgames 
Sign-up for updates: https://www.glassbreakersgame.com/#newsletter-signup

Website: https://www.glassbreakersgame.com/ 
Instagram: https://www.instagram.com/glassbreakersgame 
X/Twitter: https://x.com/GlassbreakersVR 

#VR #gaming #metaquest #strategy
